assessments.reasoning: In [C] cuestionario-ene-2020.pdf, relationship among household members is captured in question pers8 strictly relative to the primary provider ('[Nombre de proveedora principal]'), rather than through member-to-member pointers or a triangular grid; thus member_to_member_relationships is false. Extended ties beyond spouse and parent-child (such as siblings, grandparents, grandchildren, in-laws, and non-relatives) are explicitly listed as options in pers8, making extended_ties true. Criteria for distinguishing multiple households within a dwelling are stated in hog2 and hog3 based on whether individuals share food expenses ('gastos para alimentación'), making multiple_household_criteria true. There are no mechanisms or variables in the instrument to delineate family sub-units or secondary nuclei within a household, so sub-units is false. Finally, although reasons for reduced hours or non-search mention caregiving (e.g., h16 option 5 and j7 option 3), the survey does not record caregiving relationships showing who provides care to whom; thus caregiving_relationships is false.
